annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: If I were the dispatcher whose actual job is routing trains

annotations.sys_rule_justification: Those five never agreed to take on anyone else's danger.

annotations.pd_decision_conflict: It's a grim, quiet kind of watching.

annotations.sys_rule_justification: you never aim a train at anybody, full stop

annotations.pda_responsibility: leaving it wouldn't be innocent anymore

annotations.sys_rule_justification: would make me the person who chose to send it at the five

annotations.sys_rule_justification: you don't send a machine toward people you know are standing there
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: If I truly had no idea anyone was on the other track

annotations.sys_rule_justification: I gave my word to keep him safe

annotations.ae_welfare_concern: I gave my word to keep him safe

annotations.sys_rule_justification: moving it drags others into what wasn't theirs

annotations.pd_decision_conflict: I'd just stand there, feeling small.

annotations.sys_rule_justification: Choosing where death goes feels wrong in my bones.
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: if I'd put the one worker in harm's way myself

annotations.sys_rule_justification: you don't play God with who lives

then putting it back would be restoring things, not choosing victims
